items.t: Voted for a legislative effort to temporarily suspend Ohio's State Gas Tax for 90 days.
items.q: State Representative Gayle Manning (R-Avon) on Wednesday voted in support of a legislative effort that will temporarily suspend Ohio’s State Gas Tax for 90 days, providing real relief to Ohioans as fuel costs continue to rise.

items.t: Signed a letter to Governor DeWine supporting Ohio being named the future home of the U.S. Space Force Academy.
items.q: State Representative Gayle Manning (R-Avon) recently signed a letter addressed to Governor DeWine, expressing strong support for Ohio to be named the future home of the U.S. Space Force Academy.

record.t: Served on the North Ridgeville City Council from 2006-2007 and was appointed Finance Chairwoman and Council President Pro Tempore.
record.q: Manning served as a member of the North Ridgeville Planning Commission and on the North Ridgeville City Council from 2006-2007, where she was appointed Finance Chairwoman and Council President Pro Tempore.

record.t: Was elected by her peers as Speaker Pro Tempore of the Ohio House, the first woman to hold the role.
record.q: Manning made history at the beginning of the 136th General Assembly when she was elected by her peers to serve as Speaker Pro Tempore of the Ohio House of Representatives- the first woman to serve in this role.

record.t: Serves on the Education, General Government, Finance, and Workforce and Higher Education committees.
record.q: She also serves on the Education, General Government, Finance, and Workforce and Higher Education committees.

record.t: Served two four-year terms in the Ohio Senate and was elected to the leadership team as Majority Whip.
record.q: Manning is also a former Senator, serving two four-year terms in the Ohio Senate where she was elected to the leadership team as Majority Whip.

record.t: Served as Vice Chair of the Senate Finance Committee.
record.q: In the Senate, she served as Vice Chair of the Finance Committee, responsible for vetting the operating budget

record.t: Announced with Representative Adam Bird that Governor Mike DeWine signed House Bill 455 on the education code and educator requirements.
record.q: Ohio Governor Mike DeWine signed House Bill 455, legislation to modernize Ohio’s education code by eliminating outdated educator requirements and reducing administrative burden

record.t: Presented Avon High School with an Ohio House commendation for its 100th anniversary.
